milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the powered rail at spawn-relative (6, 0, 6) and be facing toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see it, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than having their back turned.
